# DbSketch

> DbSketch is a .NET CLI tool that generates database schema diagrams from live SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and MySQL databases.

DbSketch reads tables, columns, primary keys, foreign keys, and database comments, then writes Graphviz DOT, Mermaid ER, or Markdown output. It is useful for repository documentation, onboarding, pull request reviews, and CI-generated schema snapshots.

## Important docs

- [README](README.md): short overview, quick start, and main example image.
- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): first local run with the minimal config.
- [Configuration](docs/configuration.md): YAML configuration reference.
- [Full config example](docs/examples/full-config.md): larger YAML example with comments, defaults, multiple diagrams, raw output, Mermaid, and DOT styling.
- [AI-assisted setup](docs/ai-setup.md): copy-paste prompts for ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, or another coding assistant.
- [Renderers](docs/renderers.md): DOT, Mermaid, Markdown, and PNG illustration notes.
- [Database comments](docs/comments.md): comment reading and overrides.
- [CI and automation](docs/ci.md): local tool manifests, CI examples, and non-interactive command options.
- [Northwind example](docs/examples/northwind.md): generated sample diagram.
- [Development](docs/development.md): build, test, packaging, and docs asset generation.

## Suggested AI task

Add DbSketch database diagram generation to this repository. Create a `dbsketch.yml` that reads `${DB_CONNECTION}`, generates Mermaid Markdown schema documentation under `docs/db`, adds or updates a local .NET tool manifest with `DimonSmart.DbSketch`, and documents the local command. If the repository already has CI, add a safe CI step that uses a secret named `DB_CONNECTION`.
